description: In-process v2/v3 REST catalog. Requires no service or network; shares the Python mock's capabilities and explicit exclusions.
on_init: CALL iceberg_test_catalog_init('{TEMP_DIR}/iceberg-native'); ATTACH '' AS my_datalake (TYPE ICEBERG, URI 'http://iceberg-mock.invalid', AUTHORIZATION_TYPE 'none', ACCESS_DELEGATION_MODE 'none', STAGE_CREATE_TABLES true); CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS my_datalake.default;
